settlementMerit.rationale: Leuchars clears the map threshold through the exceptional Romanesque St Athernase Church, two documented walking routes and unusually strong rail-and-parking access. The audit found no qualifying current café-led stop, picnic facility or public toilet, so the score remains a measured 68.
